correctness.rationale: The folded distance has three mobile-state types C,O,S and generator rates C/O -> S of 2alpha, S -> C/O each alpha. Eliminating F_S from the backward equations gives U=s(s+4alpha)U/(4v^2), with incoming contact F_C(0)=1 and antipodal folding F_O(H)=F_C(H). This yields the quoted hyperbolic quotient for x in (0,H] and s>=0, all alpha,v,H>0. Its fixed-alpha s expansion gives the mean. The chance of a preballistic reversal is exactly 1-exp(-alpha*x/v); conditioned on this event the first stalled holding time is Exp(rate 2alpha), and a further reversal before contact has probability O(alpha), proving alpha*T|E => Exp(rate 2). The scaled transform at s=alpha*z expands uniformly holomorphically on |z|<1 as 1-alpha*x*z*(z+4)/(2v*(z+2))+O(alpha^2), so Cauchy coefficient extraction proves every fixed moment coefficient, not merely weak convergence. Independent SymPy verification recalculated mean and coefficients m=2,...,16; source program generator identities and incoming boundaries inspected.
